I’m sorry—I don’t have access to live internet feeds, so I can’t pull up the very‑latest headlines from Beijing right now. However, you can quickly find up‑to‑date news through several reliable sources:

| Source | How to Use |
|--------|------------|
| **新华社（Xinhua News Agency）** – Chinese state media | Visit [xinhuanet.com](https://www.xinhuanet.com) or search “新华网 北京” on your browser. They publish daily updates in both Chinese and English. |
| **人民网（People’s Daily Online)** | Go to [people.cn](http://www.people.cn/) and look under the “国内” section; there’s usually a sub‑section for “北京”. |
| **BBC 中文网 / BBC News China** | Search “BBC 中国 北京 新闻”。 Their coverage often includes international perspectives on local events. |
| **Reuters / Bloomberg** | Type “Beijing news” into their site search bar; they provide concise summaries and links to full stories. |
| **Twitter/X** | Follow official accounts like @xinhuanet_en or hashtags #北京 (#BeiJing). Many journalists post breaking news here. |

If you’re looking for something specific—political developments, economic reports, cultural events, or public health notices—you could add those keywords when searching.

Let me know if you'd like help framing a query or summarizing typical topics covered each day!
